svg.title: North Atlantic Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 3300 km. NOAA glossary regional continuation from the vicinity of 40 degrees N, 50 degrees W southeast of Grand Banks toward the western approaches of the British Isles. OSW chooses a nominal terminal gate west of Ireland, with southern/northern approach alternatives. Excludes Gulf Stream upstream, branches toward Iceland, the onward Norwegian/Canary flows and recirculation. A selected approach route is not the length of the entire branching Gulf Stream System. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate NOAA North Atlantic regional route — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: NOAA currents glossary; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
